definitions.explanation: A date on which an event is commemorated each year.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{記念日|きねんび}だ。
{結婚|けっこん}{記念日|きねんび}に{花|はな}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought flowers for our wedding anniversary.

examples.japanese: {記念日|きねんび}に{特別|とくべつ}な{食事|しょくじ}をする。
examples.english: To have a special meal on the anniversary.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{会社|かいしゃ}の{創立|そうりつ}{記念日|きねんび}で、{社員|しゃいん}みんなで{祝|いわ}った。
examples.english: Today is the company's founding anniversary, and all the employees celebrated together.

examples.japanese: {結婚|けっこん}10{周年|しゅうねん}の{記念日|きねんび}に、{二人|ふたり}で{初|はじ}めて{出会|であ}った{場所|ばしょ}を{訪|おとず}れた。
examples.english: On our 10th wedding anniversary, we visited the place where we first met.

notes:
{記念日|きねんび} can refer to both personal anniversaries (like wedding anniversaries) and public commemorative days.

COMMON TYPES:
- {結婚|けっこん}{記念日|きねんび}: wedding anniversary
- {創立|そうりつ}{記念日|きねんび}: founding anniversary
- {終戦|しゅうせん}{記念日|きねんび}: end of war memorial day
